_comment: Data-source subscriptions, keyed by short alias. Add a subscription your metric scripts need here (name + real Hive/Spark table it points to), save the file, then reference it from a script via metric_scripts.subscriptions.get_subscription('alias'). Table names below are placeholders -- replace with your real internal table names; do not commit real internal table names to a public repo.

okved_reference.description: Industry classification (OKVED) reference table, one row per INN.

opf_reference.description: Legal form (OPF) reference table, one row per INN.

tb_reference.description: Territorial bank (TB) assignment, one row per INN, partitioned by month.

tenure_reference.description: Client tenure with the bank, one row per INN.

chod_source.description: Net operating income (ЧОД) source table, one row per INN per month.

chep_source.description: Net economic profit (ЧЭП) source table, one row per INN per month.

turnover_source.description: Account turnover source table, one row per INN per month.

revenue_source.description: Revenue source table, one row per INN per month.

sdo_source.description: СДО source table, one row per INN per month.
